message.content:
The title of “best player” in soccer is always debated and depends on the criteria you use—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or overall skill. As of 2026, many consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top contenders:

| Player | Current Club | Key Strengths | Recent Highlights |
|--------|--------------|---------------|-------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, longevity | 2025 MLS MVP, 2026 Copa América winner |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain | Pace, finishing, versatility | 2025 Ligue 1 top scorer, 2026 FIFA World Cup finalist |

Other players frequently mentioned include **Erling Haaland** (scoring machine), **Kevin De Bruyne** (creative midfield maestro), and **Neymar Jr.** (technical flair). Ultimately, the “best” player often comes down to personal preference and the specific role you value most on the pitch.
